steps.title: Validate bounded configuration
steps.explanation: The host accepts fixed scenarios, a bounded turn count, an SDK budget threshold and supported effort values. It never accepts an arbitrary cwd or tool callback from the browser.

steps.title: Reset the classroom project
steps.explanation: Each experiment starts from trusted fixture bytes in its own private directory. Resetting a scenario does not touch your other repositories.
anchors: for (const name of ["notes.md", "status.txt", ".claude/settings.json"]) await writeFile(resolve(cwd, name), await readFile(resolve(ROOT, "fixtures/project", name)));

steps.title: Choose available and pre-approved tools
steps.code:
// Selected option properties.
tools: readOnly
  ? ["Read", "Glob", "Grep"] : ["Read", "Edit"],
allowedTools: readOnly
  ? ["Read", "Glob", "Grep"] : ["Read"],
steps.explanation: tools defines availability. allowedTools is a separate pre-approval list. In the approval experiment Edit remains available even though only Read is pre-approved.

steps.title: Apply the explicit Edit block
steps.explanation: The blocked and read-only experiments add Edit to disallowedTools. The rest of the array also excludes shell, write and web tools. A bare tool-name block removes Edit from model availability.

steps.title: Select filesystem settings
steps.explanation: Only the blocked experiment loads the project settings source. Its settings file allows Edit, while the programmatic deny removes it. Other experiments isolate filesystem settings with an explicit empty array.

steps.title: Preserve the process environment
steps.explanation: The TypeScript env option replaces the subprocess environment, so the host spreads inherited values before adding its own configuration. The UI projects only the harmless classroom value and never dumps keys.

steps.title: Call query with the composed options
steps.explanation: The fixed prompt and composed object start one real SDK query. The SDK handles model and tool orchestration; the host observes the resulting stream.
anchors: const run = query({ prompt: PROMPTS[config.scenario], options });

steps.title: Inspect actual init availability
steps.explanation: The host narrows system/init and records the model, actual tool list and permission mode. The student checks this observation against the requested option configuration.
anchors: if (message.type === "system" && message.subtype === "init") emit({ type: "initialized", model: message.model, tools: message.tools, permissionMode: message.permissionMode });
steps.narration: Step eight. The host narrows system/init and records the model, actual tool list and permission mode. The student checks this observation against the requested option configuration. The source label identifies the corresponding application statements.

steps.title: Guard each classroom path
steps.explanation: PreToolUse checks every requested file operation against the fixed workspace. Passing the guard does not approve an unresolved permission request; it leaves the permission flow to continue.
anchors: if (pathAllowed(cwd, input.tool_name, input.tool_input as Record<string, unknown>)) return {};

steps.title: Resolve the unlisted Edit approval
steps.explanation: The real canUseTool callback automatically approves only Edit on the private status file in the approval scenario. It records its actual decision before returning. Other requests are denied.
anchors: return allow ? { behavior: "allow", updatedInput: input } : { behavior: "deny", message: "Only the controlled status.txt Edit approval is supported." };

steps.title: Preserve the typed SDK outcome
steps.explanation: The host preserves the actual subtype and is_error distinction. A one-turn limit stays error_max_turns, even if some text or a tool request arrived first.

steps.title: Read the actual file after completion
steps.explanation: The finally block closes the query and reads the real status file. The resulting changed flag provides file evidence independently of the model summary, including on interrupted or limited runs.
anchors: emit({ type: "workspace", stage: "after", files: after, changed: before.status !== after.status });
